description: Timor-Leste GIS Portal is a data resource listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets under the section "East Timor", published or maintained by the publisher of websig.civil.ist.utl.pt. Wide range of datasets for East Timor, including infrastructure, natural environment, road networks, base maps, elevation and more. Coverage: East Timor (national); layers named in the list entry only. The list files it under "East Timor". The entry links to websig.civil.ist.utl.pt. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-free-gis-data-list.
